title: Oven Roasted Algerian Cod Bake
description: A cultured and comforting dish featuring cod, perfect for a sick day, with a wood-fired bake and high protein content, finished with a cheese pull.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and brush with olive oil.
Place the cod fillets on the baking sheet and season with garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Drizzle lemon juice over the cod fillets.
Bake the cod in the preheated oven for 12 minutes.
Remove the cod from the oven and top each fillet with feta cheese.
Return the cod to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove the cod from the oven and let it rest for 2 minutes before serving.
